<p style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Site Supervision (Trees) </span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">-&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;">Site Supervision (Trees) - The details of the approved document

throughout the course of the demolition and site works. A final Certificate of
Completion shall be submitted to&nbsp;and agreed in writing by&nbsp;the Local
Planning Authority at the conclusion of all site works&nbsp;and prior to the first
occupation of the development hereby approved. The works shall be carried out
